exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.description: BC/DR drills and incident response exercises. Required by NIS2 Art. 21(2)(c).
exercises.helpText: Plan and document business continuity and disaster recovery exercises. NIS2 requires regular testing of your continuity plans. Record exercise type, participants, findings, and follow-up actions.
exercises.empty: No exercises planned yet. Schedule your first drill.
exercises.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this exercise?

fieldDescriptions.title: Name of the exercise or drill (e.g., 'Q1 Ransomware Tabletop', 'DR Failover Test').
fieldDescriptions.exerciseType: Select the exercise format: tabletop (discussion-based), technical (hands-on), red team (adversary simulation), or full scale (live drill).
fieldDescriptions.domain: Security domain being tested (e.g., incident response, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis communication).
fieldDescriptions.scheduledDate: Date when this exercise is planned to take place.
fieldDescriptions.completedAt: Date when this exercise was actually completed.
fieldDescriptions.scenarioDescription: Describe the simulated scenario, including threat actor, attack vector, and expected organizational response.
fieldDescriptions.facilitator: Name of the person responsible for planning and leading this exercise.
fieldDescriptions.lessonsLearned: Document key findings, gaps identified, and recommended improvements from this exercise.
